CAPE TOWN · 1 TO 5 MARCH
come to south africa with us.
Hey {{ subscriber.first_name | default: "there" }},
If you're an ex-athlete who wants to go independent as a coach, mentor or consultant, and you need help working out how, you should consider joining our free South Africa trip.
It's also a chance to get the training partner community back. We'll train together, run workshops, do activities during the day, and have a class holiday while we're out there.

01When: 1st to 5th March
